project_info.color_palette: Ocean blue, bright yellow, sand beige, white

main_subject.detail: A beach-collage summer sale poster with a blue sea backdrop and torn-paper sand foreground. Main heading reads 'DEAL XIN CHAO HE' and giant yellow title 'UU DAI NGAP TRAN'. Three dark-blue badges show 'GIAM DEN 49%++', 'VOUCHER 250.000D', and 'DEAL DUOI 9.000D'. The top-right badge says 'CON 3 NGAY' and 'NGAY 15 SALE GIUA THANG'. Various products and accessories are collaged around the sand, including a large white suitcase, pink cushion compact, blue bottle, handheld fan, striped towel, sunglasses case or box, and envelope-like paper craft. A small badge reads 'MUA SAM XU HUONG'.
main_subject.style: Cutout-style summer retail collage with bold sale typography and scrapbook-like beach merchandising

Surrounding elements: Shopee logo, badges 'GIAM DEN 49%++', 'VOUCHER 250.000D', and 'DEAL DUOI 9.000D', top-right countdown 'CON 3 NGAY' and 'NGAY 15 SALE GIUA THANG', 'MUA SAM XU HUONG' badge, and multiple cutout products including a suitcase, compact cushion, blue bottle, mini fan, striped towel, and paper props. Technical style: graphic collage sale poster with cutout merchandising elements, bright playful summer lighting, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
